title: ENGIC 02 - PRODIGE 86-FOLFIRINOX SBA- Phase II randomized trial evaluating modified FOLFIRINOX and FOLFOX in the treatment of locally advanced or metastatic small bowel adenocarcinoma
official: ENGIC 02 - PRODIGE 86-FOLFIRINOX SBA- Phase II randomized trial evaluating modified FOLFIRINOX and FOLFOX in the treatment of locally advanced or metastatic small bowel adenocarcinoma
summary: Main objective: Assessment of the percentage of patients alive without progression at 8 months
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Histologically proven adenocarcinoma of the small intestine (duodenum, jejunum, ileum)
2. Metastatic or locally advanced unresectable tumour with curative intent
3. Patient who never received first-line chemotherapy
4. Measurable lesion according to RECIST 1.1 criteria
5. ECOG status < or = 2 for patients under 70 years, or 0 or 1 for patients over 70 years
6. Life expectancy estimated at over 3 months
Exclusion criteria:
1. MSI/dMMR tumor
2. Treatment with a cytochrome P450 inhibitor within 4 weeks prior to the administration of the protocol treatment
3. Uncontrolled inflammatory bowel disease and/or unresolved bowel obstruction
4. Administration of live vaccines within 28 days prior to randomization
5. Adenocarcinoma of the ampulla of Vater
6. Neutrophils < 1500/mm3, platelets < 100 000/mm3
7. Hemoglobin < 9 g/dL, total bilirubin > 1.5x normal, alkaline phosphatase > 2.5x normal (or >5x normal if liver metastases), creatinine clearance > or = 40 ml/min. according to MDRD
8. Adjuvant chemotherapy completed less than 6 months ago
9. History of myocardial infarction within the last 6 months, severe coronary artery disease or severe heart failure
10. Severe renal failure
11. Peripheral sensory neuropathy with functional discomfort
12. Active and/or potentially severe infection or other uncontrolled conditions
